```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA welcomes the creation of a Working Group to advocate for LGBTQIA+ liberation, create educational programs within DSA, coordinate efforts with like-minded groups, publish papers and pamphlets and support legislation to abolish discrimination against the LGBTQIA+ community, among other activities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports the continued protection of same-sex marriages in all the States and Territories of the United States of America, but views marriage as only a first step in recognizing the diversity of human relationships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA calls for full legal protections against discrimination based on sexual orientation and/or gender identity in housing, jobs, education, public accommodations, health care and other areas of civil and political life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA advocates for local and federal non-discrimination laws.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA insists that religious beliefs cannot be used to justify bias.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA calls for the repeal of state sodomy laws and other anti-LGBTQIA+ discriminations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA opposes efforts of all American entities to impose anti-LGBTQIA+ legislation abroad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA recognizes that discrimination based on sex, gender and identity most often disproportionately affects women and people of color.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports making public schools safe and bias-free for LGBTQIA+ students.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports defending the free speech and expression of LGBTQIA+ students in schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes that LGBTQIA+ students should have full access to facilities reflecting their gender.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes that LGBTQIA+ students should have inclusion in all events and activities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports freedom for LGBTQIA+ students to organize gay-straight alliance clubs in all levels of education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
